faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers on how we scope, deliver, and protect quality across our service lines.

scope.question: What scope of work does Northern Meteor typically deliver?
scope.answer: We deliver general contracting and multi-discipline construction packages spanning commercial, industrial, civil, and infrastructure works — coordinated under a single project control framework.

sectors.question: Which sectors do you serve?
sectors.answer: Our capabilities cover commercial buildings, industrial facilities, infrastructure, roads, civil works, MEP packages, maintenance, and project management support.

quality.question: How is quality controlled during execution?
quality.answer: Quality is managed through inspection points, material control, documented verification, and continuous alignment with design intent throughout the programme.

safety.question: How do you manage health, safety, and environment (HSE)?
safety.answer: HSE procedures, site supervision, and risk reviews are embedded in planning and daily operations — protecting people, plant, and the public.

engagement.question: How do engagements typically begin?
engagement.answer: We start with a clear brief and scope discussion, then structure planning, interfaces, and delivery controls before mobilisation — so expectations and accountability are aligned early.

timeline.question: How are schedules and interfaces managed?
timeline.answer: Programmes are sequenced with realistic planning, proactive risk identification, and transparent progress reporting so interfaces are resolved before they affect the critical path.

response.question: How quickly will you respond?
response.answer: We aim to acknowledge quote requests within one business day and schedule a follow-up once the brief is clear.

info.question: What information should I include?
info.answer: Share project type, location, timeline, and any constraints. The more specific the brief, the faster we can advise.

visit.question: Can we schedule a site or office visit?
visit.answer: Yes — after an initial review we can arrange a meeting or site walk when it helps clarify scope.

languages.question: Do you communicate in Arabic and English?
languages.answer: Yes. Our public site and team support both Arabic and English.

attachments.question: Can I attach drawings or documents?
attachments.answer: Attachment storage is being prepared. For now, describe the documents in your message and we will request files securely when needed.
